prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: mypy 2>&1 | tail -40; cat pyproject.toml; git ls-files
cd src/trailhead; cat -n elevation.py pace.py report.py track.py; git log --stat | head -20; grep -rn "None\|ele" ../../tests ../../README.md | head -60
cd ../..; sed -n 25,60p README.md; cat tests/conftest.py src/trailhead/plan.py src/trailhead/cli.py; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5

python - <<'EOF'
import re,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('src/trailhead/track.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''    def length_km(self) -> float:
        return sum(self.leg_lengths_km())
''','''    def length_km(self) -> float:
        return sum(self.leg_lengths_km())

    def elevations(self) -> list[float]:
        """Elevation of every point in metres, with the gaps filled in.

        A point without an elevation takes that of the nearest earlier point that
        has one or, if there is none, of the nearest later point. A track where no
        point has an elevation is a `TrackError`.
        """
        known = [point.ele for point in self.points if point.ele is not None]
        if not known:
            if self.points:
                raise TrackError("no point of the track has an elevation")
            return []
        filled: list[float] = []
        last = known[0]
        for point in self.points:
            if point.ele is not None:
                last = point.ele
            filled.append(last)
        return filled
''')
p.write_text(s)
p=pathlib.Path('src/trailhead/elevation.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''    elevations = [point.ele for point in track.points]
    return max''','''    elevations = track.elevations()
    return max''')
s=s.replace('''    for (a, b), km in zip(pairwise(track.points), track.leg_lengths_km(), strict=True):
        if km == 0:
            continue
        steepest = max(steepest, abs(b.ele - a.ele) / (km * 1000) * 100)''','''    legs = zip(pairwise(track.elevations()), track.leg_lengths_km(), strict=True)
    for (start, end), km in legs:
        if km == 0:
            continue
        steepest = max(steepest, abs(end - start) / (km * 1000) * 100)''')
p.write_text(s)
p=pathlib.Path('src/trailhead/pace.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('counted_changes([p.ele for p in track.points])','counted_changes(track.elevations())')
p.write_text(s)
p=pathlib.Path('src/trailhead/report.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('gain_and_loss([point.ele for point in track.points], threshold)','gain_and_loss(track.elevations(), threshold)')
p.write_text(s)
p=pathlib.Path('src/trailhead/cli.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''    try:
        track = load_track(args.file)
    except (OSError, TrackError) as exc:
        print(f"trailhead: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    if args.command == "summary":
        print(format_summary(summarise(track, args.fitness, args.threshold)))
    else:
        for line in describe_plan(split_days(track, args.max_hours, args.fitness)):
            print(line)
    return 0''','''    try:
        track = load_track(args.file)
        if args.command == "summary":
            lines = [format_summary(summarise(track, args.fitness, args.threshold))]
        else:
            lines = describe_plan(split_days(track, args.max_hours, args.fitness))
    except (OSError, TrackError) as exc:
        print(f"trailhead: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    for line in lines:
        print(line)
    return 0''')
p.write_text(s)
EOF
mypy; ruff check; python -m pytest -q | tail -1
printf 'lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,100\n0,0.02,\n0,0.03,160\n' > $TMPDIR/g.csv; printf 'lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,\n' > $TMPDIR/n.csv
for f in g n; do PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary $TMPDIR/$f.csv; echo "exit $?"; done; PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead plan $TMPDIR/g.csv

PYTHONPATH=src python - <<'EOF'
from trailhead.track import parse_track, TrackError
from trailhead.report import summarise
from trailhead.plan import split_days
from trailhead.cli import main
import tempfile, pathlib
t = parse_track("lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,100\n0,0.02,\n0,0.03,160\n")
print(t.elevations(), [p.ele for p in t.points])
print(summarise(t)); print(split_days(t))
d = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); f = d / "n.csv"; f.write_text("lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,\n")
print("exit", main(["summary", str(f)]))
EOF
